# Test fixtures

`gfm-0.29-extensions.json` holds the 24 extension examples (table, strikethrough, autolink,
tagfilter, tasklist) extracted from the GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec 0.29
(`test/spec.txt` in github/cmark-gfm, commit 27d942c8b0a62d192f616e5bf3578f4b6a89e180).

Copyright (C) John MacFarlane and GitHub, Inc. Licensed under
[CC-BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The examples are used unchanged
apart from conversion to JSON. This directory is test data only and is not part of the npm package.

The CommonMark 0.31.2 examples are not copied into the repository; they are read from the
`commonmark-spec` development dependency (also CC-BY-SA 4.0).
